scripts.build: bun run --filter '@beinfi/sdk' build && bun run --filter '@beinfi/nextjs' build && bun run --filter '@beinfi/cli' build && bun run --filter 'create-beinfi-app' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@beinfi/*' typecheck && bun run --filter 'create-beinfi-app' typecheck
scripts.publish:dry-run: bun run build && npm publish --dry-run --workspace @beinfi/sdk && npm publish --dry-run --workspace @beinfi/nextjs && npm publish --dry-run --workspace @beinfi/cli && npm publish --dry-run --workspace create-beinfi-app
